summary.executive_summary: Draft features high-impact industry metrics but exhibits a severe factual discrepancy in North American payment volume ($45T claimed vs $14.2T verified by Nilson Report). In addition, colloquial terms ('tons of') and repetitive company name openers weaken the institutional authority required for Chief Risk Officers.

findings.excerpt: Financial institutions processed over $45 trillion in digital payments across North America last year.
findings.explanation: Claim directly clashes with the 2024 Nilson Report benchmark citing $14.2 trillion in total North American payment volume.
findings.suggested_action: Update stated figure to '$14.2 trillion' to align with authoritative payment industry benchmarks.
findings.evidence_notes: Nilson Report (2024): Total North American digital and card payment volume was $14.2 trillion.

findings.excerpt: complies fully with the Federal Reserve FedNow ISO 20022 mandate finalized on November 15, 2023.
findings.explanation: Date claim conflict: The FedNow ISO 20022 service implementation deadline was March 2023.
findings.suggested_action: Verify and align regulatory timeline with the Federal Reserve Financial Services Bulletin.
findings.evidence_notes: Federal Reserve Bulletin: ISO 20022 deadline was March 2023.

findings.excerpt: ...Tons of banks have already replaced their fraud engines...
findings.explanation: Informal, vague quantifier ('tons of') violates institutional banking brand voice guidelines.
findings.suggested_action: Replace 'Tons of banks' with specific verified counts or enterprise customer tiers (e.g., 'Over 35 regional institutions').

findings.explanation: 3 consecutive sentences begin with the identical subject 'FinShield', creating a rigid promotional rhythm.
findings.suggested_action: Combine into a single unified value proposition or vary grammatical starters.

findings.excerpt: Our FinShield solution analyzes transactions in under 12 milliseconds.
findings.explanation: Claim is supported by benchmark specifications in engineering documentation.
findings.suggested_action: Maintain claim; accurately verified by whitepaper benchmarks.
findings.evidence_notes: FinShield Whitepaper: Median inference latency benchmark is 11.8 milliseconds.
